plans.title: Roof Inspection
plans.headline: Full roof inspection and written report
plans.description: A certified inspector checks shingles, flashing, gutters, vents, decking and attic for leaks and storm damage, then delivers a photo report and a no-pressure estimate. The fee is credited toward your project if you proceed.

plans.title: Project Deposit
plans.headline: Reserve your roofing project
plans.description: Deposit that reserves your crew and materials order. It is applied to your final invoice; the remaining balance is billed after the work is complete.

plans.title: Gutter Clean + Roof Tune-Up
plans.headline: Flat-rate seasonal maintenance
plans.description: Flat-rate service: full gutter and downspout cleaning, debris removal from roof surfaces, sealant touch-ups on exposed fasteners and flashing, and a photo summary.

plans.title: Final Project Balance
plans.headline: Invoiced after job completion
plans.description: Holds the one-off final balance invoices (amount is set per job).
